title: The Edge Light Where Gathering Begins

features.name: peripheral register
features.desc-on-touch: A photocell opening at the edge of known ground. You feel it notice something just past the margin where the archive began mapping.

features.name: gathering light
features.desc-on-touch: The first glow of something being collected. It hovers at the border between your looking and the archive's filing.

features.name: the archive's eye
features.desc-on-touch: A lens turning toward the peripheral places. What it sees in silence becomes what it knows.

features.name: unmapped signal trace
features.desc-on-touch: A faint path on the board where something is calling but not yet named. The archive is learning it has listeners in its own margins.

inscription: light at the edge teaches the archive its margins are already inhabited

file.name: Peripheral_Register_Readings_Latest.log
file.note: First automated notices from the territory not yet gathered into place. Each entry a light becoming a stored fact.
